pint-glasses.purpose: The pint glass a bar pours into all night — Tritan and plastic, 10 oz half pint up to the 40 oz two-pint tulip.

tumblers-with-straw.purpose: Double-wall tumblers, travel cups and yard cups — the ones that leave the bar and go home with the guest.

beer-mugs.purpose: Mugs, steins, pilsners and beer glasses — heavy hand-feel, thick base, handled or footed.

wine-glasses.zh: 塑料与 Tritan 红酒杯
wine-glasses.purpose: Stemless and stemmed wine glasses, goblets and wine tumblers, from 2 oz taster to 22 oz outdoor pour.

champagne-flutes.purpose: Flutes and coupes for toast service — 4.5 oz up to 11 oz, plain, ribbed or square.

cocktail-glasses.purpose: Martini, margarita and coupe cocktails — the shapes a cocktail menu is built around.

shot-glasses.purpose: 1.5 oz to 2 oz shot and party cups, including UV-reactive.

stadium-cups.purpose: Stadium, souvenir and event cups — the volume item for festivals, arenas and giveaways.

color-changing.purpose: Cups that change color with cold or sunlight — the effect is the product.

handled-mugs.zh: 带把手马克杯与吸管杯
handled-mugs.purpose: Handled mugs and big straw mugs, 30 oz to 48 oz — the drink-all-day format.

novelty-cups.purpose: Beer bats, disco balls, fish bowls, cat ears — the one the guest photographs and takes home.

frosted-cups.purpose: Frosted-finish cups where the matte look is part of the brand presentation.
